description: Defines a Serializable Java class ShoppingCartData representing shopping cart details in a web application, including fields like message, code, quantity, total, subtotal, and lists of OrderTotal and ShoppingCartItem objects.

classes.name: ShoppingCartData
classes.description: A data holder class for shopping cart information, used within the web shopping cart module.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the total quantity of items in the cart.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the total quantity of items in the cart.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amount as a String.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Returns the list of shopping cart items.

methods.name: setShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Sets the list of shopping cart items.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Returns the list of OrderTotal objects.

methods.name: setTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of OrderTotal objects.
